body:
N-34 SLICE 2 IS BUILT, NOT WALKED (helper-n34s2, 23 Nov 2026; server only; branch task/N-34-slice2-album-pass; the item stays todo, slices 3 to 7 are open; nothing marked; no device, VM or live request).

BUILT: migration 0019_album_identity.sql (identity_tried_at, identity_rev, identity_outcome, identity_reason; no journal table, that is slice 5s); refs.release_facts_to_fill (fill only); album_pass.AlbumFinder, an errand BEFORE the cover finder (one transaction per song that re-reads the row; matched, none and held remembered with a reason; an outage stores nothing; the [Unknown Album] literal forgotten for every song it examines; held pair logged by ids; worklist refs skipped); album_finder.decide, one ask-and-decide function shared with the dry run; the cover finder on the same matcher (closes B-133 a for the finder and the keepers picture call, one question per release; B-133 c stays open for slice 3).

THE RULING OF 17 NOV, AS BUILT: what cannot be justified is a re-askable none with a reason, never matched. (1) A same-artist sole best-of is accepted unless its title carries a compilation marker (Greatest Hits, Best Of, Collection ...), then none/compilation_title; a best-of called Gold passes. (2) STEP 0, no network, pinned in tests/test_album_withheld.py: the recordings hold ONE proven single/album pair (Creature, same ISRC and length, 457 days) and three by title (127, 84, 64 days), all of one band and one album: too few to show where a window ends, so the window is NOT FROZEN and a single before its album is none/single_before_album until the live dry run. (3) No discography lookup. Also latin_spelling_only (a non-Latin song whose only hits are Latin-spelled: remembered none, counted apart in the report) and identity_rev (none and held asked again when the rule changes; the data that decides a verdict is pinned with the revision).

TOLERANCE: could not be frozen (the recordings hold no kept file); still 3 s, STOP-GAP(N-34 tolerance), trigger moved to the live dry run with --music-root.

DEPLOY PRECONDITION: merging is not the risk, running the image is. On its first hourly tick the pass stamps up to 200 songs and a matched song is never asked again. Read the live dry run over a COPY of the servers database before an image with this runs on VM 108 or the owners server. The only off-switch is ENCORE_CATALOGUE=0 (it also stops pictures). The dry run DECIDES with the same function as the pass but does not SELECT the same songs (it does not skip worklist refs, leaves out songs with no kept file unless --all, ignores stored identity).

STOP-GAPS (price, trigger, task N-34 itself): single window unset; compilation markers (English words); tolerance 3 s; the keeper passes the refs LISTED length to the picture lookup until slice 3 reads the file; album_pass calls refs.recheck_pending twice: N-36 must remove both (marked, in the inventory of test_stopgap_expiry).

NOT DONE: files are not written, moved or retagged; new keeps ask no album; Creatures twin stays a pair; an ISRC a song already holds is not compared; placeholder stays on songs the pass does not examine.

PROOF: 168 new tests; 86 mutations killed, 2 equivalent named in the PR; whole suite, ruff, format, mypy, check_rows, check_order: see the PR. Questions for the lead are in the PR: a dedicated ENCORE_ALBUM_PASS switch before the first public image? count worklist refs apart in the dry run? markers read as downgrade (flip: empty COMPILATION_MARKERS and bump the revision).
